D08.critic_comment: Consistent with the corrected D07 evidence; power plants are the operationalized critical-facility category.

D09.critic_comment: Confirmed: modified IEEE 14-bus + hypothetical WDS (synthetic topology) with real Arizona survey/census-calibrated demand-adjustment behavior.
